name: 06_redemption_terms
description: Three series of the same issuer redeemed after the 18-month lockup, each priced by a different term: S1 by the hurdle (no payments), S2 by k × D_avg (high first-year payments), S3 by the remaining cap (nearly capped). The redemption gate (every ended period reported, nothing due) is exercised; holders claim the redemption price and units burn; releases continue after redemption.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.
